name: Le Cercle
summary: Cinematic long-scroll luxury real-estate site that alternates dark full-bleed hero moments with light editorial sections; the visitor 'walks through' the property as they scroll.

motion.entrance: media reveals via clip-path wipe up (inset 0 0 100% 0 -> 0) with a slow zoom (scale 1.12 -> 1); headline lines stagger in (y 30 -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1); CTAs fade-up last
motion.scrollLinked: gentle parallax push on the hero media as the user scrolls past
motion.reducedMotion: render final state: static image fully revealed, headline + CTAs visible, no parallax

sections.notes: Dark cinematic hero: serif headline ('Live Where the Sun Meets the Sea') over a warm property photo, pill CTAs 'View Properties' + 'Book a Tour'.
Light band, oversized serif statement ('For those who travel like it's an art form').

motion.entrance: image reveals via clip-path + slow zoom (scale 1.08 -> 1); heading fades up
motion.scrollLinked: subtle parallax on the villa image

sections.notes: 'Our Villas' intro with a modernist villa hero image.

motion.hover: card lifts (translateY -6px) + shadow; image zooms to 1.05
motion.reducedMotion: static cards, no lift or zoom

sections.notes: Two-column property cards (Villa Blanca, Casa Dorada).

motion.entrance: form panel fades + slides up (y 20 -> 0); fields focus-ring transitions on focus
motion.reducedMotion: static panel, focus ring still applies

sections.notes: 'Get In Touch' form in a dark closing section.

interactions.pattern: scrollytelling: alternating dark/light full-bleed sections reveal on scroll
interactions.reducedMotionFallback: render each section static, no scroll-linked reveal

buildWithOnia: Compose alternating dark/light section bands with ONIA tokens (navy/cream analog per client).
Rebuild scroll reveals with the existing motion util + a mandatory reduced-motion static fallback; budget LCP/CLS for big media.
Reuse the property-cards block (photo + name + one-line desc) for units/listings.
Reuse the inline-quote-form block (the one added for Bolivian Electric) for the 'Get In Touch' closing.
